projectDescription: GPU-accelerated real-time AI fitness coach that tracks 17 body keypoints via YOLOv8 to detect bad exercise form and score injury risk 0–100 using your webcam.
keyFeatures: Real-time 17-keypoint pose estimation at 20+ FPS on NVIDIA GPU via YOLOv8m-Pose
ML-based exercise auto-detection (98% accuracy across 7 exercises) using MLPClassifier
Live injury risk scoring from 0–100 based on joint angles and posture rules
Exercise-specific form analysis with dedicated rules per exercise
Voice alerts via native Web Speech API — no external libraries required
Multi-person tracking with automatic focus on the largest detected person
Video upload mode for post-workout analysis
Session history chart with 60-second scrolling risk graph and CSV export
Hardware-adaptive: NVIDIA GPU recommended, falls back to CPU automatically
publicApiSurface: WebSocket /ws — live webcam pose stream returning frame, analysis, and timestamp
POST /analyze-image — single image pose analysis returning annotated frame + analysis
POST /analyze-video — full video analysis returning NDJSON stream of frame + analysis per processed frame
run_inference(frame) — YOLOv8 inference returning keypoints array for largest detected person
analyze_posture(keypoints) — returns issues, angles, risk_score, exercise_detected
draw_skeleton(frame, keypoints, risk_score) — draws annotated skeleton overlay on frame
angle_between(a, b, c) — computes joint angle in degrees from three (x,y) points
tools/collect_data.py — webcam keypoint data collector for classifier training
tools/extract_from_videos.py — bulk keypoint extractor from video files
tools/train_classifier.py — trains and saves exercise MLPClassifier
